s.n: Foci $(\pm ae,0)$, directrices $x=\pm\frac ae$, latus rectum $\frac{2b^2}a$, transverse axis $2a$, conjugate axis $2b$.
Angle between asymptotes $=2\tan^{-1}\frac ba$. Equation of the hyperbola and of its asymptotes differ only by a constant: $H=0$, $A=H+k$, conjugate $=2A-H$.

s.q: Chord of contact, midpoint chord, pair of tangents

s.n: Asymptotes of $xy=c^2$ are the axes; vertices $(\pm c,\pm c)$; foci $(\pm\sqrt2c,\pm\sqrt2c)$.

s.q: Product of perpendiculars from foci to a tangent
Area of triangle formed by a tangent and the asymptotes
s.n: The point of contact is the midpoint of the intercept between the asymptotes.

s.q: Product of distances from a point to the asymptotes

s.f: \text{tangent bisects the angle between focal radii (internally)}

s.q: A circle meeting $xy=c^2$ at four points $t_1,\dots,t_4$
s.n: Also the centroid of the four points is the midpoint of the circle's centre and the hyperbola's centre.
